finding.title: Missing Security Header
finding.evidence: The HTTP response does not include the expected security header.
finding.impact: Missing browser security controls can increase exposure to certain client-side attacks.
finding.remediation: Configure the required security headers at the application or web-server layer.

finding.title: Exposed Debug Information
finding.evidence: The synthetic debug endpoint exposes implementation details in its response.
finding.impact: Exposed debug information can provide useful details to an attacker during reconnaissance.
finding.remediation: Disable debug output in non-development environments and restrict diagnostic endpoints.
